title: The freshness-at-lookup row of design.md says when and on which run its 227 of 387 figure was measured
goal: The design.md row holding 227 of 387 names its run date, that it is the later of the day's two runs, and the not-found and unchecked lines

run:
import re, sys
row = [l for l in open('kb/_self/design.md', encoding='utf-8') if '227 of 387' in l]
ok = bool(row) and bool(re.search(r'20\d\d-\d\d-\d\d', row[0]))
print('227 of 387 row dated:', ok); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

notes: review of SP-gea4jifz, S3: design.md:44 (added by ST-6m5kgbh5 when the README dropped the figure) has no date, does not say it is the later of two runs that day, and leaves out the 9 not-found and 2 unchecked lines that the source report (kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.md, 'Freshness of the cited sources') holds.
